problem: The density register has not been kept
action: Late afternoon at the office counter. The dealer is turning the pages of a slim hardbound register with his right hand, faster than someone reading — he is looking for something written and not finding it. His left hand is flat on the counter taking his weight. He is leaning over the book, head down. The pages he is turning past are ruled and bare.
lighting: Low warm afternoon light coming in sideways, throwing his shadow long across the counter. Dust in the beam. The rest of the office falls into shadow.
camera: Shot from slightly above and to the side, chest-up, so we see both his face and the pages turning under his hand. He is centre frame, sharp. 35mm.
detail: CRITICAL — the pages are unused. Faint pre-printed ruling only; NO handwriting, NO figures, NO words, NO letters, NO numbers, no pen marks anywhere. His eyebrows are drawn together. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Looking for proof that something was done, and page after page finding nothing.
motion: He turns one more page. His shoulders drop very slightly. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: डेंसिटी बुक कभी देखी ही नहीं। भरी है या ख़ाली, पता ही नहीं था।
